newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices extend daytime gains.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices extend daytime gains.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices rose on Thursday's ACCESS session, extending a daytime rally on perceptions of tightening unleaded gasoline supplies, traders said.
Gasoline futures for June delivery rose 1.58 cents a gallon to 62.50 cents, while front month crude oil gained 72 cents a gallon to $20.34 a barrel.
"It looks like we got a continuation of earlier levels," a trader said. Rumors of refinery problems in the U.S. Gulf and forecasts of heavy summer demand lifted futures values earlier.
Crude oil for June delivery on NYMEX traded at $20.40 several hours into ACCESS, up six cents a barrel from the daytime close.
Volumes stood at 689 lots, with total volumes at 1,381 lots.
Traders said June crude futures could reach $21 a barrel if they broke through the $20.53 a barrel level, a key level.
After-hours, NYMEX June heating oil rose 0.22 cents a gallon to 54.60 cents, as 59 lots changed hands overall.
NYMEX June unleaded gasoline futures were flat at 62.50 cents a gallon with 163 lots traded in June and 168 total.
